male.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit Image1 ONLY, keep the SAME original character identity, hair shape/length/parting, face/eyes, ears, bare-neck proportions and EXACT8 orientations/layout. Image2 is the new sharp pixel DETAIL target for this same head, not a different character. Repaint all8 head views of Image1 to the clean deliberate pixel clusters shown in Image2.
Original sheet4columns×2rows: S(front),SW(front-left),W(left profile),NW(back-left); N(back),NE(back-right),E(right profile),SE(front-right). All8 must stay in original slots, same head/core skull size, same face width, jaw/chin and neck, eye line and physical scale. Do not make a bigger head to add detail. Preserve all hair asymmetry across views, back hair must be genuine backview without eyes.
STYLE: professionally hand-pixelled RPG game asset, logical80×80 px per slot, hair physical width44-48px. Absolutely discrete hard square pixels with fine controlled clusters; six clean hair tones arranged as connected fine tapered strands, five skin tones with crisp brows/eye whites/amber irises/pupils and nose/chin shadow. Razor clean material-color outline, NO blurry feathering, no airbrush, no gradient interpolation, no dust/noise, no painterly skin, no chunky black outline. DO NOT simply apply a sharpen filter. These are repainted source details. At native size each eye must read cleanly. Match line density across all8, not only frontal.
Avatar contains full hair, ears, face and a SHORT BARE SKIN NECK ONLY. No shoulders, shirt, collar, jewelry or background. Common skull/neck anchors, no cut-off strands. Ample transparent padding so no view touches another cell. Actual transparent alpha. No text/grid/drop-shadow.
Identity constraint: Image1 is authoritative for the original open amber eyes, brow angle, eyelid/iris proportions and face expression. Do NOT narrow eyelids or enlarge eyes based on Image2. Image2 is for connected crisp hair/face pixel rendering only.
